name: Acid Cooling Chillers
title: Acid Cooling Chillers, Coimbatore | Win Equipments
description: Chillers for acids and corrosive process fluids, engineered to order by Win Equipments, Coimbatore. Share the fluid, concentration and heat load.
card: Chillers engineered to order for acids and corrosive process fluids.
lede: Cooling acids and other corrosive fluids needs heat exchangers and pumps in materials that the fluid will not attack. Win Equipments builds these chillers to order, choosing materials from the fluid, its concentration and its temperature.
needs: Process fluid, concentration and operating temperature
Heat load (kW) or flow rate with inlet and outlet temperatures
Direct fluid cooling or an intermediate water loop
Plant ambient temperature and available power supply
Site constraints such as fumes, enclosure or indoor/outdoor location

faqs.q: Why is there no standard model table?
faqs.a: These units are engineered to order around your duty, so we size and quote each one from your requirement rather than publishing a fixed model list. Send your requirement and our engineers will reply with a recommended configuration.
